title: Would you put your words in my cube?
author: AlgaeNo3373

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body:
A universe in a cube. 

A universe of three thousand and seventy two stars. 

Each one of them is mapped to the neurons inside GPT Two - MLP layer 5. 

When input goes in, peak neuron activation is measured and the neuron's index is returned. 

It's twin solar system lights up from the darkness. 

This is the visual, the game. It's all about coverage: activate as many neurons as you can. 

Push words in, and see topology form. 

Intentionally very simple so that beginners like me can start to learn, building intuition.
